svg.title: Rate Limiting & Throttling
svg.desc: Rate Limiting & Throttling. Cap how fast each client may call (token bucket) and shed the excess with 429s. Step 1, Token bucket: Each API key has a bucket of 5 tokens, refilled at 2 per second. Every request spends one. Step 2, Burst, then 429: A sends 8 at once: 5 spend the stored tokens, 3 find the bucket empty and get 429 + Retry-After. Step 3, One limit, many instances: Three gateways check one shared store, so A's 6 calls are counted once: 5 pass, the 6th gets 429. Step 4, Shed load by priority: Everyone is within quota, yet the service is full: it sheds a report with 503 and admits checkout.

g.text: Each API key has a bucket of 5 tokens, refilled at 2 per second. Every request spends one.
A sends 8 at once: 5 spend the stored tokens, 3 find the bucket empty and get 429 + Retry-After.
Three gateways check one shared store, so A's 6 calls are counted once: 5 pass, the 6th gets 429.
Everyone is within quota, yet the service is full: it sheds a report with 503 and admits checkout.
a token bucket per API key
one shared count: 5 pass, the 6th gets 429
every client is within its own quota,
yet together they fill the service
